name: Cablecraft Motion Controls
old_description: In a world on the go, failure is not an option. That’s why, for over seventy years, Cablecraft has specialized in designing engineered solutions that keep things moving, reliably. But we don’t just manufacture quality motion control products and assemblies—our engineering and manufacturing experts collaborate with you to design answers to your most pressing motion control problems.
about:
Cablecraft Motion Controls traces its lineage to 1920, when J.J. Tourek Manufacturing Co. began producing precision screw-machine components in Chicago. The Cablecraft brand itself was founded in 1949 in Tacoma, Washington, as a specialist in aircraft cable assemblies. A third strand, Superior Ball Joint Corp., started in Fort Wayne, Indiana, in 1954. These operations were later combined with Cable Manufacturing & Assembly to form the current entity, now headquartered in St. Matthews, South Carolina.

The company designs and manufactures control cables (push and push-pull), rod ends, ball joints, mechanical linkages, and remote actuation products. It also produces mechatronic assemblies — electronic controls, mechanical systems, and electro-mechanical components — for vehicle platforms. Engineering and manufacturing teams work together to develop proprietary components that reduce design cycles, tooling costs, and total product cost, and they deliver assemblies ready for installation.

Cablecraft serves aerospace (sport aircraft), powersports, construction equipment, light-vehicle, and engine-control markets. Customers range from OEMs seeking standard catalog parts to engineering teams requiring custom motion-control solutions for mission-critical applications.

The firm emphasizes an application-focused philosophy: its engineers partner with customers early to solve motion-control problems rather than simply sell parts. This approach, backed by more than 75 years of combined experience, aims to provide ideas, advice, and engineered solutions that improve precision and reliability.
